lesson.grammar_point: opinion adjectives with because and so

listenings.text: Gabriela, you have to watch this. I finished the whole first season last night, and I did not sleep. It is only eight episodes, so it is a perfect weekend. The plot is a little strange at the beginning, and I almost stopped, because the first episode is slow and honestly a bit boring. But then, in episode three, everything changes, and it becomes really exciting. The actor who plays the brother is fantastic; he is only seventeen, and he is better than half the adults on television. I will not tell you the ending, because I do not want to give you a spoiler. Just promise me one thing: do not binge-watch it in one night like I did, because tomorrow you have school.

So, I watched the first two episodes yesterday and here is my recap. The plot is simple: a girl moves to a new town and she does not know anybody at school. In episode one she is completely alone, and honestly that part is a little boring, because nothing happens. But episode two is exciting, because she finds an old letter in her locker and the whole story changes. My favorite actor is the woman who plays the teacher. Her face says everything, and she almost never speaks. I will not talk about the ending of episode two, because I hate spoilers and Ryan hates them too. I want to binge-watch the rest this weekend, but my mother says I have to study first.

extra_audio.text: First, you say what you watched and you say, I watched the first two episodes yesterday. Next, you explain the plot in one sentence and you say, a girl moves to a new town. After that, you give your opinion with a reason and you say, episode one is boring, because nothing happens. Then, you say what changed and you say, episode two is exciting, because she finds an old letter. Finally, you recommend it and you protect your friend and you say, watch it, but I will not tell you the ending, because I hate spoilers.

reading.rtitle: Two reviews of the same episode
paras: REVIEW 1 -- five stars. I watched this episode three times and I still love it. The plot is simple but it works: a girl arrives in a new town, and nobody speaks to her for twenty minutes. Some people say that part is boring, but I think it is the best part of the season, because you feel exactly what she feels. The actor is only sixteen and she is incredible.

REVIEW 2 -- two stars. Honestly, this episode is boring. Nothing happens for twenty minutes, and then the ending arrives too fast. The plot of the season is interesting, so it is a shame. The acting is fine, but a good episode needs more than one good actor. My advice: watch episode one quickly and start the season at episode two, because that is where the story really begins.

A note from the site: please do not put the ending in the comments. Somebody is always watching this season for the first time, and a spoiler ruins it for them. If you want to binge-watch the whole thing this weekend, go ahead -- but come back and tell us what you thought, not what happened.
